Metadata.title: Kawu — AI showing reports
Metadata.description: Turn every real-estate showing into an evidence-backed client report.
Metadata.imageAlt: Kawu — Every showing, remembered with evidence.

Auth.brandBody: Capture the walkthrough once. Kawu turns it into a structured, client-ready report you can review with confidence.
Auth.privacy: Private by default. Nothing is sent without your confirmation.
Auth.loginBody: Continue reviewing and delivering your showing reports.
Auth.signupBody: Set up your private workspace for professional buyer reports.
Auth.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

Home.title: Showing reports
Home.subtitle: Review every walkthrough, follow the evidence, and deliver reports your clients can trust.
Home.emptyBody: Start a showing or adjust your filters to bring the right reports into view.

NewShowing.title: Create a new showing
NewShowing.subtitle: Choose the property and client, then upload the recording and supporting media. Kawu will take it from there.
NewShowing.propertyBody: Choose an existing property or enter a new address. A client is optional.
NewShowing.addressPlaceholder: Start typing an address or property name
NewShowing.newPropertyHint: No saved property selected. A new property will be created from this address.
NewShowing.uploadBody: Upload at least one audio recording. Photos and video are optional and stay linked to this visit.
NewShowing.dropBody: Audio, photos, and video are uploaded securely
NewShowing.audioRequired: Add at least one audio recording before finishing the showing.
NewShowing.failed: The showing could not be uploaded. Please try again.

Showing.processingBody: Transcription, room detection, and report generation are running. This page updates automatically.
Showing.processingFailedBody: The pipeline stopped before the report was ready.
Showing.reportPendingTitle: The report is not ready yet
Showing.reportPendingBody: Keep this page open or return later. The draft will appear when processing finishes.

ReportEditor.guardReview: Confirm or edit at least one observation before confirming the report.
ReportEditor.guardSensitive: Review {count, plural, one {# sensitive observation} other {# sensitive observations}} before confirming.
ReportEditor.missingReport: There is no report to save.
ReportEditor.confirmed: Report confirmed and ready to send.
ReportEditor.rewriteApplied: Suggested wording applied to the source observation.
ReportEditor.rewriteFailed: The suggested rewrite could not be applied.

Observations.configUnavailable: Observation categories are unavailable until the vertical configuration endpoint responds.

Transcript.audioHint: Open evidence from any observation to jump to the exact moment in the recording.

Delivery.title: Send the confirmed report
Delivery.body: Email the client or create a private link you can paste into any conversation.
Delivery.linkBody: Create a secure link to the confirmed, branded report.
Delivery.noHistory: No delivery activity in this session.

Clients.title: Clients
Clients.subtitle: Keep each buyer's showing history and comparisons together.
Clients.name: Full name
Clients.deleteConfirm: Delete this client? This cannot be undone.
Clients.emptyBody: Add your first buyer to start building their showing history.

ClientDetail.empty: No showings are linked to this client yet.

Properties.title: Properties
Properties.subtitle: Every visit stays independent while the property history remains easy to find.
Properties.deleteConfirm: Delete this property? This cannot be undone.
Properties.emptyBody: Properties appear here as you create and capture showings.

PropertyDetail.empty: No visits have been recorded for this property.

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.subtitle: Keep your professional identity consistent across every client report.
Settings.name: Name
Settings.profileReadOnly: Profile editing will become available when the account update endpoint is enabled.
Settings.brandingBody: These details appear on confirmed client reports.
Settings.logoFailed: The logo could not be uploaded.
Settings.sampleBody: A clear, evidence-backed summary of the property showing appears here for your client.
Settings.previewNote: This preview mirrors the backend report style. Confirmed reports are rendered and snapshotted by the backend.
